hypothesis: A constrained one-iteration Codex run may emit an admissible cache policy or a useful negative result under the existing scrubbed-prompt and trusted-grounding machinery.
evidence_requirements: Preserve the complete RDE result, claims, iteration, and audit bundle.
Treat model output as untrusted until the grounding oracle and existing holdout machinery execute.
An external grader must inspect the bundle before any discovery claim; intra-family diversity is not independent corroboration.
kill_conditions: No candidate is admitted or no candidate clears the existing holdout: record a negative result, not a near-discovery.
Any run whose configured domain, role roster, fanout, or iteration budget differs from this manifest is invalid for this campaign.
Any apparent improvement without an external review of the audit bundle remains exploratory.
